world_boss_advance_time_help: How early to depart for the boss spot, e.g. 00:05:00 means 5 minutes early
world_boss_target_name_help: Keywords matched against the target name after clicking the target button, separated by commas; empty means using the boss name
close_game_wait_duration_help: Close the game when the next task is further than this many minutes away (disabled when the option above is Idle); 0 disables
close_emulator_wait_duration_help: Close the emulator when the next task is further than this many minutes away; 0 disables
emulator_startup_lead_time_help: Start the emulator this long before the task begins
when_task_queue_empty_help: Idle keeps the game as is and does nothing; closing the game reduces CPU usage while idle
queue_mode_help: Instances run tasks one by one to avoid hitting the server at the same time; instances without the execution token wait with the 'When Task Queue Empty' strategy
queue_idle_threshold_help: How many minutes to hold the execution token while idle, only used when Queue Mode is on
antiban_enable_help:
Enable schedule constraints (sleep window, daily active limit, forced rest) to avoid 24/7 or all-night running that looks abnormal to the server.
Human-like clicking/swiping is always active and is not controlled by this switch.
sleep_start_help: Enter the sleep window at this time. All operations stop and the game/emulator is handled by the 'When Task Queue Empty' strategy, then wakes up automatically. Cross-midnight is supported.
sleep_end_help: Leave the sleep window and resume running at this time.
daily_active_limit_help: Force a long rest after the accumulated active time reaches this value (reset after resting). 0 means no limit. Format: d hh:mm:ss.
long_rest_duration_help: How long to rest after the daily active limit is reached. Format: d hh:mm:ss.
min_run_interval_help: Anti-ban: minimum interval between two card-farming runs. 0 (default) keeps the original logic. Format: d hh:mm:ss.
quiz_api_key_help: DeepSeek API key. Leave empty to use the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable; stored only in the local config file
quiz_model_help: Model name, default deepseek-flash (supports image input)
quiz_api_timeout_help: Timeout in seconds for one API call. Each question has 20s, keep a reasonable budget
quiz_use_thinking_help: Enable thinking mode: more accurate but slower and pricier
quiz_total_questions_help: Number of questions in one quiz session
quiz_time_limit_help: Countdown seconds per question, used for the fallback pick
quiz_ask_again_help: Ask the AI again for questions not verified in the bank
quiz_unknown_fallback_help: Fallback when the bank misses and the AI is unavailable: skip / always A / random
quiz_save_screenshot_help: Save quiz screenshots to log/quiz for manual bank filling
quiz_learn_from_llm_help: Write AI answers into the bank (marked unverified, promoted once the game confirms correct)
quiz_bank_repo_dir_help: Git repo dir sharing the question bank (default: quiz-db next to the project; clear = local only)
quiz_bank_repo_url_help: Repo url (prefilled by default, cloned automatically when the directory is missing)
